name: black-friday-launcher
description: Helps you get your Black Friday sale ready, with your sales page, order form, special offers, thank-you page and launch emails, all as drafts for you to look over first. Operator detail, not for the client: puts the separate page skills together into one walk for the buyer. The answers are checked before anything is built, and building the pages is kept apart from what the buyer clicks through later. The buyer's path is the verified-payment path: U1 after the original purchase, D1 only when U1 is declined, U2 only after a confirmed U1 or D1 purchase. There is no membership question and nothing is held back for want of one. Council advice is recorded during planning and never blocks. The order form is the native Convert and Flow form; each price choice on a selection page or a combined page gets its own order form, so the checkout mode is resolved, not open. Only verified offer facts are used: a defaulted price or level fails the build. Cross-sales is carried as an offer relationship on the thank-you page with teaching content marked pending. Registered as number 83 and turned on in 999 once everything it needs is present.
intent_triggers: run the launcher for my launch
compose my upsell and downsell pages
